text: Figure 7.4: Execution of a mode switch provided by an Host Software Cluster • The mode manager software component calls the Rte_Switch API, to do the mode switch notification • The Cross Cluster Communication gets notified via the call of the Rte_ Rips_Switch Service. • If the mode queue is empty , this Rte_Rips_Switch can be used to determine the first on-transition value. Alternatively , this is also possible in the mode switch task(s) before first Dispatchers are scheduled.
